title: Ky Dickens' controlled telepathy tests with Mia in a rented Glendale house

tellings.quote: brought this young girl Mia up from Mexico you know most of the family didn't even speak English only her aunt Sophia did and I rented a house in Glendale California

plain: In 2023 a young girl named Mia was brought up from Mexico to a rented house in Glendale, California, so that her apparent ability to read minds could be tested under controlled conditions. The documentary maker Ky Dickens, who made a film about children said to be telepathic, tells Michels she ran the tests herself. She says most of Mia's family spoke no English and only the girl's aunt, Sophia, did, and that she rented the house herself to set up the tests. If the tests held up, they would point to a child reading other people's thoughts.
